hotels.description: Wedged between the sparkling Bay of Bengal and a tranquil lagoon, Uga Jungle Beach is where nature and comfort coexist effortlessly. Picture opulent cabins with jungle, lagoon or ocean views, quietly hidden in the greenery so you can soak up the scenery without intrusion. Here, raw coastal beauty and modern creature comforts are rolled into one purely indulgent hideaway. Perched on Sri Lanka's stunning east coast, adventure and relaxation are just steps away. Watch dolphins dance in the waves, snorkel through crystal waters or wander Trincomalee's historic streets. When the sun starts to dip, kick back and watch exotic birds drift over the lagoon. Every day can be packed with discovery or left blissfully empty - the choice is yours. Dig into freshly caught seafood or international favourites at the open-air restaurant, then toast the evening with cocktails at the beach bar. Recharge at the jungle-surrounded spa, or float in the serene pool without a care in the world.
